name: @estates/cardchain
description: ESTATES live card-NFT lifecycle: the Fate/Treasury decks are minted as concealed 1-sat BSV card NFTs (bank-held) at genesis, and every draw/pass is a REAL tx that SPENDS the current holder's card UTXO and re-seals the face to the new holder — so the previous holder LOSES access and the spent outpoint is on-chain dead. Bridges @estates/params + @estates/deck + @estates/cardnft.
